new_jobs.title: General Manager
new_jobs.jd: About Twister5 Twister5 (極風雲創) has completed its public share registration and is now moving toward an IPO. We're mid-transformation — shifting from project-based delivery to an AI-driven, subscription-first business model built for recurring revenue and scalable growth. We're looking for a next-generation operator to build that engine: AI × Subscription × Recurring Revenue × Scalable Growth. The Opportunity This is not a caretaker GM role. We're looking for a CEO-caliber Growth Leader — someone who understands markets, customers, products and technology; who can turn AI into a real, sellable business model; who can run Sales, Product, Technology and Operations as one team; and who is comfortable standing in front of the Board, owning the P&L and the growth outcome. Your mission: take Twister5 from public registration to IPO, while building a scalable, high-quality recurring revenue engine powered by AI and subscription. What You'll Own AI & Subscription Transformation • Convert project-based AI revenue into ARR/MRR — building the packaging, pricing, licensing and renewal/upsell/cross-sell mechanics behind it, with Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and partners moving in sync. Go-to-Market & Revenue Growth • Build a repeatable enterprise sales engine plus a channel and partner ecosystem, own the full customer lifecycle from acquisition to expansion, and run pipeline, forecasting and revenue performance. P&L & Business Performance • Full ownership of company P&L — Revenue, ARR, Gross Margin, EBITDA and Cash Flow — backed by a data-driven management culture and a real balance between growth, profitability and cash. Product & AI Commercialization • Translate customer needs and market opportunity into an AI product roadmap; drive product-market fit, standardization and scale, and reduce the custom, one-off work that caps growth. Organization & Leadership • Design the org structure for an AI/subscription business, build a fast, high-performance leadership team, and recruit and develop AI, SaaS, Sales and Product talent with KPIs and incentives that fit a growth-stage company. International & Overseas Expansion • Take the business into new markets (Southeast Asia, Japan, North America and others) — building overseas teams, agent/distribution networks and partnerships, localizing product and pricing, and standing up the compliance, tax and data-sovereignty capability cross-border operations require. Evaluate M&A, joint ventures or strategic investment where they accelerate this. Corporate Governance & IPO Readiness • Partner with the Board on the listing roadmap and the operational, financial and internal-control maturity an IPO demands, and build the investor relations function alongside underwriters, auditors and legal counsel. • Stand up AI Governance appropriate to the company's stage — AI product/service risk, data governance, information security and privacy, regulatory compliance, and AI investment and resource allocation. Who We're Looking For We're not looking for the longest tenure — we're looking for someone who can make the company grow fast. Ideally, you bring: Business Leadership • 10+ years of experience, including 5+ years leading a P&L, business unit or function — as GM, VP, BU Head, Director or equivalent, with real revenue, product, team or P&L accountability, and the range to go from strategy to execution. AI / SaaS / Subscription • Hands-on experience in one or more of: AI / Generative AI, SaaS, subscription business, cloud, cybersecurity, or other recurring-revenue enterprise technology. Growth & Transformation • A track record of scaling a company, business unit or product line, ideally through a business-model transformation, with real command of enterprise sales, GTM, channel or strategic partnerships and sharp commercial judgment. Capital Markets • Public company or listed-company experience is a strong plus, especially IPO, listing, M&A, strategic investment or investor relations exposure, plus comfort communicating with the Board, shareholders and outside institutions. International Exposure • Experience opening overseas markets or running cross-border/regional operations, ideally with working knowledge of at least one target market (Southeast Asia, Japan, North America, etc.), cross-cultural team management, and working-level English (or another language) to engage overseas customers, partners and investors directly. Leadership Profile • Growth Mindset — never satisfied managing what already exists; always chasing the next growth curve. • Builder — turns AI, product and market insight into a business that actually sells. • Owner — accountable for outcomes, not just for a function. • Fast & Decisive — reads a situation quickly, decides, and drives the organization to execute. • Customer & Market Driven — genuinely understands enterprise customers and where the market is moving. • People Leader — attracts strong talent and builds a high-performing team. • Board-Level Communicator — thinks about the business the way the Board and capital markets do. • Global Mindset — ready to take the organization beyond Taiwan and into overseas growth. Compensation & Long-Term Incentive Total Annual Compensation: NT$5,000,000, made up of base salary, year-end bonus and an annual performance bonus tied to company and individual KPI achievement. Equity incentives are calculated separately from the NT$5,000,000 total and scaled to the candidate's experience and scope of responsibility — including employee stock options, RSUs/restricted stock, and a listing-milestone incentive. Why Join Twister5? This is a chance for a next-generation operator to genuinely reshape a technology company. You'll: • Lead the AI + Subscription business transformation and build the company's next revenue growth engine • Drive AI product commercialization and a scalable recurring revenue model • Build the enterprise sales and channel ecosystem, and expand into overseas markets • Report directly to the Board for business outcomes, and help take the company from public registration to IPO • Shape long-term strategy and major decisions — and share in the company's growth through equity If you want to do more than run a company — if you want to build the business model and growth curve for the next generation of AI companies — Twister5 wants to talk to you. #GeneralManager #CEO #AI #SaaS #Subscription #EnterpriseAI #RecurringRevenue #Growth #BusinessTransformation #IPO #Taiwan

new_jobs.title: Taiwan Controller
new_jobs.jd: At Air Products, we reimagine what’s possible. By tapping into the motivation of our people and our collective experience, we create the ideas and innovations that drive us forward. The role ensures financial integrity, provides business decision support, strengthens controls, and leads the Taiwan finance analysis team to support profitable growth, operational productivity, asset optimization, investment decisions and strategic initiatives. Nature and Scope The role supports Taiwan’s Industrial Gases business across major product lines and supply modes, with particular focus on onsite, electronics, liquid bulk, micro bulk, helium and packaged gases businesses. Partnering with the Taiwan GM and leadership team, the incumbent supports new project bidding, business planning, performance improvement, cost competitiveness, risk management and execution of Taiwan business priorities. The role provides decision support to general management, commercial, operations, asset management, business development, supply chain and functional finance teams. The incumbent may also serve as finance representative or director on Taiwan joint venture boards, as applicable. The position reports functionally to the Asia CFO to ensure independence, effective controls and alignment with Asia Finance and BDS priorities. The role works closely with FBS Shared Services and corporate finance experts including Treasury and Tax. The role leads a three-member Taiwan finance analysis team based in Taipei. **Principal Accountabilities** Act as the primary finance partner to the Taiwan GM and leadership team, providing financial advice, business insight and decision support on strategy, business planning, pricing, cost management and key commercial decisions. Ensure financial integrity and effective controls for Taiwan by applying corporate finance policies, supporting the business decision process, reviewing key transactions and maintaining proper documentation. Lead Taiwan BDS and finance analysis support for new project bidding, investment analysis, contract renewals, small onsite and support capital projects, productivity initiatives and asset optimization. Drive high-quality reporting, forecasting and performance analysis for Taiwan, including operating plan support, variance analysis, performance metrics and timely input for Asia consolidation. Identify business and financial risks, support mitigation plans and provide fact-based analysis for operational decisions, new assets on-stream, supply mode economics and profitability improvement. As the Board Director, represent Finance in Taiwan JV governance, Board matters, audit support, tax matters and other local finance requirements as applicable, protecting Air Products’ shareholder interests while supporting JV performance. Act as the bridge between the Taiwan business team, Asia Finance, FBS Shared Services and corporate finance functions including Treasury and Tax to coordinate communication and resolve issues. Lead, coach and develop the Taiwan finance analysis team, ensuring strong technical capability, business partnering mindset, disciplined execution and effective talent development. **Job Requirements** Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or related discipline; MBA or professional finance qualification preferred. Minimum 10 years of finance, controllership, business decision support or related experience, preferably in Electronics (Semiconductor even better) or other fast growing industrial & manufacturing environment. Strong business acumen, solid cash flow project investment analysis, general FP&A skillset to support a sizable company, accounting, problem-solving and risk management capability. Quick adaptability to work and engage in a fast-growing business environment. Proven leadership, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to partner effectively with senior management and cross-functional teams. Demonstrated maturity to deal with key stakeholders in complicated JV environment. Founded in 1940, Air Products is a world-leading industrial gases company and has a proud history of innovation, operational excellence, with an unwavering commitment to safety and environmental stewardship. Working together, we are taking our passion and diverse backgrounds forward to reimagine what’s possible and generate a cleaner future for our customers, our communities, and the world.
